title: O-RAN-Native Jamming Detection Under Network Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2610.20816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radio-frequency jamming threatens cellular network operations in contested environments. The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture exposes per-User Equipment (UE) telemetry through the E2 interface, enabling Key Performance Indicator (KPI)-based jamming detection without proprietary hardware. However, operational deployment demands detection methods that generalize across heterogeneous networks. We propose a Statistical Ensemble Method (SEM) combining adaptive Median Absolute Deviation (MAD)-based baseline detection, count-based anomaly detection, and abrupt change detection through a weighted voting system. SEM operates in two modes: a cold-start mode requiring no labeled data for immediate deployment, and a supervised mode where parameters are refined offline via grid search as labeled data accumulates. We evaluate SEM against five machine learning (ML) classifiers and five deep learning (DL) sequence models using approximatel

translated_title: 网络异构环境下的O-RAN原生干扰检测
translated_abstract: 射频干扰在对抗性环境中威胁着蜂窝网络的运行。开放无线接入网（O-RAN）架构通过E2接口公开每用户设备（UE）的遥测数据，使得无需专有硬件即可实现基于关键性能指标（KPI）的干扰检测。然而，实际部署要求检测方法能够在异构网络之间具备泛化能力。我们提出了一种统计集成方法（SEM），通过加权投票系统将基于自适应中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的基线检测、基于计数的异常检测以及突变检测相结合。SEM支持两种运行模式：无需标注数据即可立即部署的冷启动模式，以及随着标注数据积累、通过网格搜索离线优化参数的监督模式。我们使用大约（原文在此处截断）将SEM与五种机器学习分类器和五种深度学习序列模型进行了评估比较。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于O-RAN E2接口KPI遥测数据的统计集成干扰检测方法（SEM），通过加权投票融合三种统计检测技术，支持无需标注数据的冷启动部署与随数据积累的监督优化，能够在异构网络间实现泛化性良好的干扰检测。
